Container.Name: Pinchflat-NGX
Container.Overview: Download and manage videos from YouTube channels and playlists. This template starts a new SQLite library. To keep an existing Pinchflat library, follow the migration guide and edit the existing container.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Change the host port if 8945 is already in use.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and settings. Use appdata backed by local storage.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Choose a writable host folder for the videos downloaded by Pinchflat-NGX.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Set an IANA time zone such as America/Regina for local times and scheduled tasks.
